text: Picture spacetime, space and time joined as cloth woven from tiny compass needles. A particle's spin is a built-in quantum property, a rule at nature's smallest scales, like one needle's direction. Einstein-Cartan gravity is Einstein's gravity extended to include spin. In that theory, all those tiny twists can twist spacetime itself. That spacetime twist is called torsion. Our illustration lights the twist only after the cloth appears. This paper contains no plots. The entire argument is equations. So how could that faint twist reverse a collapse?
